object.attr: derived: architecture review F2, open question Q5, failure analysis CF-G32 (change 8), review Q3. In 0.3.0 a commit validates the window's copy but commits the files on disk. Test a change made while the commit dialog is open. That a commit records what its validation read is VER's (review Q13). The moment between this check and the commit is an accepted risk (review Q73).
object.description: If a file of the document or of a parent document changed on disk since the Document Editor read the file, other than a figure redrawn since, the Document Editor shall refuse to commit.
